title: Design: Vendor invoice due date for a day-of-month term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure vendor invoice A, dated Oct 5, 2026, is saved for a vendor who holds the shop's own term due on day 10 of the following month.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p7-09-a-vendor-invoice-today-net-60.png, ct-p7-10-vendor-on-10th-of-next-month-oct-5-due-nov-10.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the vendor invoices list (Parts, Vendors, Vendor Invoices).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open vendor invoice A.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Vendor Invoice card shows "Invoice date" Oct 5, 2026 and under it "Due date" Nov 10, 2026, in the same layout as today's card (compare ct-p7-10-vendor-on-10th-of-next-month-oct-5-due-nov-10.png and today's ct-p7-09-a-vendor-invoice-today-net-60.png; the yellow highlight on the picture is not part of the screen).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R2: “A "day of the following month" term is always due in the month after the invoice date, whatever the day of the invoice: with day 10, an invoice dated Oct 5 and one dated Oct 28 are both due Nov 10.”
  • S7-R9: “A vendor invoice stores no term. Its due date is calculated by the same rules from the vendor's term when the vendor invoice is created, recalculated when its invoice date or its vendor changes, and stored.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("A vendor invoice today (Net 60)", "Vendor on 10th of next month: Oct 5, due Nov 10"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p7-09-a-vendor-invoice-today-net-60.png
  • ct-p7-10-vendor-on-10th-of-next-month-oct-5-due-nov-10.png

The design's own words:

  • “Same date rule as customer invoices: always the 10th of the next month; a shorter month uses its last day.”
  • “The highlight marks what to check; it is not part of the screen.”
